VTS-Meldestelle

A specifically designated geographical position where a vessel is required to contact and report to the Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) with position, status, and intentions.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is VTS-Meldestelle?

In this glossary, VTS-Meldestelle refers to: A specifically designated geographical position where a vessel is required to contact and report to the Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) with position, status, and intentions.

How is VTS-Meldestelle used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Schiff passiert VTS-Meldestelle Alpha, Position zweiundfünfzig Grad Nord, einunddreißig Grad Ost, einlaufend zu Liegeplatz fünf. Meldung wie vorgeschrieben."

Definition

A specifically designated geographical position where a vessel is required to contact and report to the Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) with position, status, and intentions.

Operational example

Vessel passing VTS reporting point Alpha, position five-two degrees north, three-one degrees east, inbound for berth five. Reporting as required.

Localized term

VTS-Meldestelle

Localized example

Schiff passiert VTS-Meldestelle Alpha, Position zweiundfünfzig Grad Nord, einunddreißig Grad Ost, einlaufend zu Liegeplatz fünf. Meldung wie vorgeschrieben.
